title: SquidSMP Spawn (Season 2)
description: The spawn of the Popular Minecraft Server, SquidSMP (Season 2) as a panorama!
body:
# SquidSMP Spawn
The beloved SquidSMP Spawn, now in a Panorama with Splash Texts and everything!

## Additions
So far, this pack adds:
- The SquidSMP Spawn as a Panorama, taken from the Top of the Main Spawn Tower!
- Custom Splash texts!
- More to come...

## Version Numbering
The versions will be numbered like: (M.mm.ss)

**M** is Major Version release. This is for Major updates like new additions.

**mm** is Minor Version Release. This is for Bug fixes and minor additions.

**ss** is for Splash text Updates. Whenever i upload a new version with new splashes, this number will go up by one. I will upload them under Beta just so you can easily sort through them.

## Note
1. If you see a warning saying the pack is Broken or Incompatible, IGNORE IT. I don't know why this happenes, but it does, so just ignore it.
